Your projects hold more than your plan's disk

Your projects hold 112.4 GB and Solo has 100 GB of disk. Your machines keep running and starting. Creating, restoring and forking projects, and growing a disk, are refused until they hold less.

Destroying a project frees what it holds. A deleted file stops counting within a day, or when its machine stops.
